_doc: Departments as data (docs/DEPARTMENTS.md). Copied to company/departments.json at founding (scripts/found-company.sh); a missing file means no departments and every tool behaves as it did before departments existed. The source of truth for who is in which department and who leads it: company/FLOOR_PLAN.md and loops.json are checked against it (company/tools/departments.js check, the departments duty, station-floor.js audit A12), never the other way round. Changed ONLY through company/tools/departments.js (create, set-lead, add-member, remove-member, move): a structural change is a governance decision (category org: the CEO or the people function may propose, the owner or the CEO applies at the level the owner set), recorded in company/work/decisions.md and the department's DECISIONS.md, and its bytes in the provenance log; locked-watch.js (owner: the people function) reports any other write. Fields: leadModelDefault = the model a department lead runs on unless the owner says otherwise. departments[] = { id (lowercase, 2-32), name, lead (a seat id from loops.json, or null: then each member's loops.json manager stands in for the lead), members (seat ids; a seat belongs to at most one department; the lead is a member), defaultClass (the task class an item from this department has when it names none: code, review, research, writing, design, ops, mechanical, general), brief (company/work/departments/<id>/BRIEF.md, written by departments.js create), routes ({ <class>: { provider, model, effort } }: the model a member's item of that class should run on; read only by routing code that ships in shadow first; written only by departments.js set-route: the owner, the CEO at the owner's models level, or the weekly routing suggestion after its veto window, docs/ROUTING.md §7), consult ({ maxPerDay, stuckAfterFailedRuns, stuckAfterRevise, stuckAfterIdleWakes, stuckOnReopen }: when a member's item goes to the lead: lib/consult.js), advisor ({ mode off|shadow|live, since, by, paused: null | {at, by owner|auto, why, evaluationHash} }: whether the lead gives advice, docs/DEPARTMENTS.md §5; absent = advisorDefaults, mode off; set only with departments.js advisor), delegation ({ mode off|shadow|live, workers [seat ids: the allowlist, inside the lead's reports in loops.json], maxWorkers, workerTimeoutMin, minPieces, maxPieces (the most pieces one split may have; also the most workers one lead run may start), prefer lanes|dispatch, since, by, withdrawn: null | {at, by auto|owner, why, evaluationHash} }: whether the lead may hand the pieces of one big item to workers on its team, docs/DEPARTMENTS.md §6; absent = delegationDefaults, mode off; set only with departments.js delegation; a withdrawn department acts as recording only) }. delegationDefaults = what every department's delegation reads unless its own key says otherwise (lib/departments.js delegationOf). advisorDefaults = what every department's advisor reads unless its own advisor key says otherwise: routine (the advise routine's name suffix), batch { minGapMin, maxWaitMin, startAt } (when the dispatcher starts the lead's advise run), packetMaxChars (one consult, heading included), premerge (advisory: the lead's verdict before a merge never blocks), autoPause { enabled, minItems, minDays, consultRate [low, high], cachedShareMin, oneShotGainPoints, reworkCutShare } (model-rank.js advisorEvaluation: the bars advice must clear, else the dispatcher pauses it; only the owner resumes). newDepartment = what departments.js create gives a new department (every number here is config the owner can tune; production scoring is expected to move them). limits.briefMaxChars / digestMaxChars = the size departments.js check holds BRIEF.md and INBOX-DIGEST.md to; limits.proposalsKeep = how many closed proposals company/state/departments-proposals.json keeps. accountable ({ mode off|shadow|live, since, by, withdrawn: null | {at, by auto|owner, why, evaluationHash}, audit { routine, risky }: the fixed model pairs (null = leadModelDefault), set only by the owner with departments.js accountable <id> audit-model; never by a router }: accountable leads, docs/DEPARTMENTS.md §8; absent = accountableDefaults, mode off; set only with departments.js accountable). accountableDefaults = routine (the audit routine's name suffix), audit { routine, risky }, risk { classes, paths, minDiffLines, words } (what makes an audit risky: it then runs on the risky pair), selfCheck { timeoutSec, noteMinChars }, packetMaxChars (one audit packet: the diff, the acceptance check and the self-check note), stallHours (an audit, or an item with no acceptance check, that has waited this long is put to the CEO in one plain line, and to the owner when the cause is one the owner controls; the CEO may then answer or drop it in the lead's place), batch { minGapMin, maxWaitMin, startAt } (when the dispatcher starts the lead's audit run), scorecard { days, spotCheckEvery, minItems, expectedCut, fallbackBelowCut } (the lead's department scorecard; model-rank.js accountableEvaluation falls the department back to recording only when the measured cut stays under fallbackBelowCut).
